The pre-registered gates are: (a) null nested AUC, |mean − 0.5| ≤ 0.03 and mean + 1.96 SE ≤ 0.53; (b) null permutation P, binomial P(K ≥ k | rate 0.05) ≥ 0.01 and chi-square goodness-of-fit P over the B + 1 values ≥ 0.01; (c) leaky reference, mean AUC > 0.75; (d) subject-blocked nulls and the ungrouped reference, as in R14f; (e) planted signal (proposed, pending Maintainer confirmation before the first run), mean nested AUC ≥ 0.70 and permutation P ≤ 0.05 in at least 90 % of replicates. Gates (a)–(d) are carried over unchanged from R14f. The full table and the seeds are in the [contract](contracts/methods-extension.md#calibration-gates).
